lead.headline: An unreleased Anthropic model just proved a quantum-computing conjecture open since 2008
lead.summary: Physical Superintelligence (PSI) says its in-house research system, running a non-public Anthropic model, proved the Aaronson–Ambainis conjecture: on random inputs, quantum computers can't be exponentially faster without a rare hidden pattern. Lean accepted the proof on day three of the run, and the system then improved the result twice. The Lean code is public; Stanford researchers who settled a special case in August call it "a huge result" and are writing an expert exposition.

number_of_day.label: OpenAI's reported valuation after raising $11B so far in a round that may reach about $20B, well short of the $30B it was said to be seeking in September.

news.headline: OpenAI raises $11B at $1.25T, while Anthropic's IPO buyers talk it down
news.summary: Bloomberg reports the round is still open and could total about $20B, below the earlier $30B goal. Hours earlier it reported that some prospective Anthropic IPO buyers see a valuation as low as $1.1T, against the ~$2T expected a month ago, with post-midterm data-centre jitters weighing on the market.

news.headline: Codex 0.167 adds an agent command center for your background agents
news.summary: Run `codex agents --no-daemon` to see every agent, with unread markers on finished results. You can also switch backends from the session picker without losing drafts, keep chats visible across model providers, preview local images while composing, and expand patch details while an approval prompt is open.

news.headline: Perplexity launches Teammates: always-on agents that own ongoing work
news.summary: Each Teammate gets its own thread, runs jobs in parallel, builds on Perplexity Computer's projects, skills and memory, and can be reached in Slack. It joins OpenAI's Dots and Claude Duet in the 24/7 agent race, but needs the $200/month Max plan. Srinivas pictures hundreds of teammates per person.

news.headline: Helsinki tightens the rules for big data centres
news.summary: New city principles require operators to bring new low-emission, non-combustion power online as their demand grows, recover waste heat at scale for district heating, prefer non-forested sites and follow Finnish labour law. The forested Henriksdal site faces resident protest and a threatened moss species, so alternatives are now being studied.

quick_hit.label: CLAUDE CODE
quick_hit.text: 2.1.319 adds `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting`: a tool call that would wait on a permission prompt gets denied and the turn keeps going. That's handy for unattended runs and subagents. MCP tasks now move to the background too.
